name: Bosa Starter Sites
author: Bosa Themes

sections.description:
Bosa Starter Sites (formerly Keon Toolset) lets you import a complete, ready-made website for your Bosa theme in one click, straight from your dashboard. Pick a starter site, import it, and replace the content with your own.

What it does

Bosa Starter Sites imports a full site at once: pages, posts, menus, widgets, and theme settings. You run the import from Appearance > Demo Import in your WordPress dashboard. It is meant for setting up a new site.

Features

  • 200+ full starter sites, free and Pro, with a filter to browse each
  • One-click import of pages, posts, menus, widgets, and theme settings
  • Elementor layouts, where the starter site is built with Elementor
  • WooCommerce sample products for store starter sites

Need only part of a starter site?

Bosa Starter Sites imports a complete website. If you only want one page or one section, use BEW, a free companion plugin on WordPress.org.

BEW brings Bosa designs into the Elementor editor as individual pieces:

  • Kits: a full design set, inserted one page at a time
  • Page templates: a complete page, such as Home, About, or Shop
  • Section templates: a single block, such as a hero, pricing table, or testimonials

That means you can add a new page to an existing site, or swap one section, without importing a whole demo. BEW includes 3,000+ templates (some are Pro), plus WooCommerce widgets and AI content generation. Browse the BEW template library.

Which one should I use?

  • Bosa Starter Sites: you’re starting a new site and want everything set up at once (Appearance > Demo Import).
  • BEW: you already have a site and want to add or redesign a single page or section inside Elementor.

Formerly Keon Toolset

This plugin was previously named Keon Toolset. Existing installs keep working and update as usual.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Bosa Starter Sites”.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Appearance > Demo Import.
sections.faq:
Where can I find the starter sites?

Go to Appearance > Demo Import after activating the plugin.

Is this the same plugin as Keon Toolset?

Yes. It was renamed to Bosa Starter Sites. Nothing changes for existing users.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is completely free. Pro starter sites are marked in the list and are included with Bosa Pro.
